api.auth_middleware.present.description: Public API routes MUST require authentication middleware.

api.deprecation.notice_days.description: Public API deprecations MUST give at least 90 days notice.

api.idempotency_key.supported.description: Payment mutation APIs MUST accept idempotency keys.

api.input_validation.present.description: Public write APIs MUST validate request schemas.

api.openapi.published.description: Externally consumed APIs MUST publish an OpenAPI document.

api.pagination.present.description: List endpoints returning unbounded collections MUST paginate.

api.payments.idempotency_required.description: Payment mutation APIs MUST require idempotency keys.

api.rate_limit.enabled.description: Public APIs MUST enforce rate limiting.

api.request_id.propagated.description: Service APIs MUST propagate a request correlation ID.

api.versioning.breaking_requires_major.description: Breaking public API changes MUST bump a major version.

api.versioning.major_for_breaking.description: Public APIs MUST NOT remove fields without a major version bump.

architecture.adr.required.description: Cross-cutting technical decisions MUST be recorded as ADRs.

architecture.review.required_tier01.description: Tier-0/1 services MUST pass architecture review before major launches.

architecture.service_tier.assigned.description: Production services MUST be assigned a service tier (0–3).

architecture.tenant_isolation.tested.description: Multi-tenant systems MUST have automated tenant-isolation tests.

bc.plan.documented.description: The organization MUST maintain a business continuity plan.

change.cab.required.description: Production changes MUST go through change advisory (CAB) when risk is high.

change.feature_flag.required.description: High-risk launches MUST be gated behind a feature flag.

change.maintenance_window.declared.description: Disruptive production changes MUST declare a maintenance window.

change.rollback_plan.required.description: Production changes MUST include a documented rollback plan.

cicd.branch_protection.deny_force_push.description: Default branches MUST deny force pushes.

cicd.branch_protection.required_checks.description: Merges MUST require green required status checks.

cicd.branch_protection.required_reviews.description: Default branch protection MUST require at least one review.

cicd.dependency_scanning.enabled.description: Application CI pipelines MUST enable dependency vulnerability scanning.

cicd.image.latest_tag.description: Production deploys MUST NOT use the mutable latest image tag.

cicd.image_scanning.enabled.description: Container build pipelines MUST scan images before publish.

cicd.prod.approval_required.description: Production deployments MUST require a human approval gate.

cicd.provenance.attestation_required.description: Production releases MUST publish build provenance attestations.

cicd.provenance.present.description: Production deploys MUST attach build provenance.

cicd.sast.enabled.description: Application CI pipelines MUST enable SAST.

cicd.sbom.published.description: Released services MUST publish an SBOM artifact.

cloud.audit.org_trail_enabled.description: The organization MUST enable an organization-wide audit trail.

cloud.audit_trail.enabled.description: Accounts MUST enable control-plane audit logging.

cloud.iac.drift_detection.description: IaC-managed environments MUST enable drift detection.

cloud.iac.required.description: Production infrastructure MUST be managed as code.

cloud.iam.admin_equivalent.description: Runtime roles MUST NOT use AdministratorAccess-equivalent policies.

cloud.object_storage.public_blocked.description: Object storage public ACLs MUST be blocked at the org policy layer.

cloud.object_storage.public_read.description: Object storage holding customer data MUST NOT use public-read ACLs.

cloud.object_storage.versioning_enabled.description: Critical document buckets MUST enable versioning.

cloud.rds.public_access_disabled.description: Managed databases MUST disable public accessibility.

cloud.root.mfa_enabled.description: Cloud account root users MUST have MFA enabled.

cloud.security_group.ssh_open.description: SSH security groups MUST NOT allow 0.0.0.0/0.

cloud.tags.standard_enforced.description: Cloud resources MUST carry the org tagging standard (owner, env, cost-center).

cloud.threat_detection.enabled.description: Cloud accounts MUST enable threat detection (e.g. GuardDuty or equivalent).

compliance.access_review.quarterly.description: Privileged access MUST be reviewed at least quarterly.

compliance.audit_log.immutable.description: Security audit logs MUST use append-only or WORM storage controls.

compliance.audit_log.immutable_store.description: Security audit logs MUST be written to an immutable or WORM-capable store.

compliance.audit_log.retention_days.description: Security audit logs MUST retain at least 365 days.

compliance.audit_log.retention_years.description: Security audit logs MUST be retained at least 1 year.

compliance.change_ticket.required.description: Production config changes MUST reference a change ticket.

compliance.dpia.recorded.description: New personal-data processors MUST record a DPIA reference.

compliance.framework.mapping_owned.description: Applicable regulatory frameworks MUST have a named control-mapping owner.

data.backup.encryption_enabled.description: Backups MUST be encrypted at rest.

data.backup.restore_tested.description: Critical backups MUST have periodic restore tests.

data.backup.retention_days.description: Critical system backups MUST retain at least 30 days.

data.backup.rpo_minutes.description: Tier-1 services MUST keep RPO at most 60 minutes.

data.backup.rto_minutes.description: Tier-1 services MUST keep RTO at most 240 minutes.

data.batch.idempotent.description: Scheduled batch jobs that mutate state MUST be idempotent.

data.classification.label_required.description: Datasets containing personal or confidential data MUST carry a classification label.

data.field.classification_present.description: Persisted customer profile fields MUST carry a data classification.

data.migration.destructive_flagged.description: Destructive schema migrations MUST be explicitly flagged.

data.nonprod.anonymized.description: Non-production environments MUST NOT use raw production PII without anonymization.

data.owner.assigned.description: Authoritative datasets MUST have an assigned data owner.

data.replica.lag_alerting.description: Primary/replica datastores MUST alert on lag above threshold.

dr.test.yearly.description: Tier-1 DR plans MUST be tested at least yearly.

endpoint.disk_encryption.required.description: Corporate laptops MUST enable full-disk encryption.

endpoint.edr.deployed.description: Corporate endpoints MUST run approved EDR.

endpoint.screen_lock_minutes.description: Corporate endpoints MUST auto lock within 15 minutes.

endpoint.usb_storage.restricted.description: Removable USB storage MUST be restricted on corporate endpoints.

finops.budget.alerts_configured.description: Cloud accounts MUST configure budget alerts.

finops.commit.coverage_percent.description: Steady-state compute MUST maintain at least 60% commit/reservation coverage.

finops.cost_center.tagged.description: Billable cloud resources MUST include a cost-center tag.

finops.idle_review.monthly.description: Accounts MUST run a monthly idle-resource review.

frontend.a11y.wcag_level.description: Customer-facing web apps MUST target WCAG 2.2 AA.

frontend.cdn.sri_required.description: Third-party CDN scripts MUST use Subresource Integrity.

frontend.cookie.secure_httponly.description: Session cookies MUST set Secure and HttpOnly.

frontend.cors.allowlist_only.description: Browser clients MUST use an explicit CORS allowlist (no `*`).

frontend.csp.present.description: Browser apps MUST set a Content-Security-Policy.

frontend.deps.audit_gate.description: Frontend releases MUST fail on high/critical dependency advisories.

frontend.secret_in_bundle.present.description: Client bundles MUST NOT embed API secrets.

frontend.sri.required.description: Third-party scripts MUST use Subresource Integrity when loaded from CDN.

iam.access_review.quarterly.description: Privileged access MUST undergo quarterly access review.

iam.break_glass.monitored.description: Break-glass accounts MUST be monitored and alerted.

iam.contractor.time_bound.description: Contractor accounts MUST be time-bound with an expiry.

iam.jml.process_defined.description: Workforce access MUST follow a joiner-mover-leaver process.

iam.password_manager.required.description: Workforce credentials MUST be stored in an approved password manager.

iam.privileged.jit_required.description: Standing admin access is forbidden; privileged access MUST be just-in-time.

iam.scim.provisioning_enabled.description: Enterprise SaaS with SCIM support MUST enable SCIM provisioning.

iam.sso.required.description: Business applications MUST use organization SSO.

identity.mfa.required.description: Administrative interactive login MUST require MFA.

identity.oauth.redirect_allowlist.description: OAuth clients MUST use an allowlisted redirect URI set.

identity.password.min_length.description: Password minimum length MUST be at least 12 characters.

identity.refresh_token.rotation_enabled.description: Refresh tokens MUST use rotation on use.

incident.postmortem.required.description: Sev-1 incidents MUST produce a blameless post-incident review.

incident.severity.taxonomy_defined.description: The organization MUST define a severity taxonomy for incidents.

kubernetes.deployment.replicas.description: Production deployments MUST run at least three replicas.

kubernetes.hpa.present.description: Variable-load production services MUST configure horizontal pod autoscaling.

kubernetes.liveness_probe.present.description: Long-running services MUST define a liveness probe.

kubernetes.network_policy.present.description: Namespaced production workloads MUST have a default-deny NetworkPolicy baseline.

kubernetes.pod_anti_affinity.present.description: Tier-1 services MUST spread pods across nodes.

kubernetes.pod_disruption_budget.max_una.description: Tier-1 PDBs MUST set maxUnavailable to at most 1.

kubernetes.pod_disruption_budget.min_ava.description: PDBs for tier-1 services MUST keep at least two pods available.

kubernetes.pod_disruption_budget.present.description: Disruption-sensitive workloads MUST have a matching PodDisruptionBudget.

kubernetes.pod_disruption_budget.selecto.description: PDB selectors MUST match the workload labels.

kubernetes.readiness_probe.present.description: HTTP services MUST define a readiness probe.

messaging.consumer.max_retries.description: Consumers MUST bound retry attempts before DLQ.

messaging.dlq.present.description: Durable consumers MUST configure a dead-letter queue.

messaging.event.pii_forbidden.description: Domain events MUST NOT carry raw government IDs or full payment PANs.

messaging.event.raw_gov_id.description: Events MUST NOT carry raw government IDs.

messaging.outbox.present.description: DB+message dual writes MUST use an outbox or equivalent.

messaging.poison.quarantine_enabled.description: Consumers MUST quarantine poison messages after retry exhaustion.

messaging.publish.blocking_unbounded.description: Request handlers MUST NOT block on unbounded broker publish retries.

messaging.schema.compatibility_checked.description: Evolving event schemas MUST pass compatibility checks in CI.

messaging.schema_registry.used.description: External event contracts MUST use a schema registry.

ml.agent.human_approval_high_risk.description: High-risk agent tools MUST require human approval.

ml.agent.unrestricted_shell.description: Agent runtimes MUST NOT allow unrestricted shell tool execution in production.

ml.dataset.access_audited.description: Training dataset access MUST be audited.

ml.feature_store.access_controlled.description: Feature stores MUST enforce authenticated, authorized access.

ml.gateway.log_redaction.description: LLM gateway logs MUST redact secrets and raw PII.

ml.llm.output_filtered.description: LLM applications MUST filter outputs for secrets and disallowed content classes.

ml.llm.prompt_injection_controls.description: LLM applications MUST implement prompt-injection controls for untrusted input.

ml.model.approval_recorded.description: Production model promotions MUST record an approval record.

ml.model.approval_required.description: Production model promotion MUST pass an approval gate.

ml.model.eval_report_present.description: Model ships MUST attach an evaluation report reference.

ml.notebook.secrets_from_vault.description: Notebooks MUST load secrets from a vault, not plaintext cells.

ml.training.lineage_recorded.description: Production models MUST record training data lineage.

ml.training_data.retention_days.description: Training datasets with personal data MUST NOT retain raw samples beyond 180 days.

mobile.crash.pii_scrubbed.description: Mobile crash reports MUST scrub PII before upload.

mobile.secrets.not_in_binary.description: Mobile app binaries MUST NOT embed long-lived API secrets.

mobile.tls.pinning_enabled.description: Mobile apps handling sensitive data MUST enable certificate pinning.

network.data_tier.private_subnet.description: Data tiers MUST run in private subnets without public IPs.

network.datastore.private_only.description: Datastores MUST not attach public IPs.

network.default_vpc.prod_forbidden.description: Production workloads MUST NOT run in the account default VPC.

network.egress.allowlist_enabled.description: PCI workloads MUST use an egress allowlist.

network.ssh.public_exposure.description: Bastion access MUST NOT expose SSH to 0.0.0.0/0.

observability.alerting.error_budget.description: SLO services MUST alert when error budget burn is high.

observability.logging.pii_scrubbing.description: Log pipelines MUST scrub known PII fields.

observability.logging.retention_days.description: Application logs MUST retain at least 30 days.

observability.logging.structured_json.description: Services MUST emit structured JSON logs.

observability.metrics.red_present.description: User-facing endpoints MUST expose rate/error/duration metrics.

observability.oncall.defined.description: Production services MUST define on-call routing.

observability.tracing.context_propagated.description: Service-to-service calls MUST propagate trace context.

ops.alert.runbook_linked.description: Paging alerts MUST link to a runbook.

ops.oncall.coverage_24x7.description: Production services MUST have 24x7 on-call coverage.

platform.cache.tenant_namespaced.description: Caches MUST namespace keys by tenant.

platform.tenant_isolation.enforced.description: Multi-tenant query paths MUST enforce tenant predicates.

privacy.breach.notify_hours.description: Confirmed personal-data breaches MUST begin customer/regulator notification workflows within 72 hours.

privacy.consent.recorded.description: Marketing personalization MUST record consent state.

privacy.cross_border.controls.description: Cross-border personal data transfers MUST use approved transfer controls.

privacy.data_retention_days.description: Personal data retention MUST NOT exceed 365 days without an approved exception.

privacy.deletion_api.present.description: Customer data platforms MUST expose a deletion fulfillment path.

privacy.dpia.required.description: High-risk personal data processing MUST complete a DPIA.

privacy.erasure.workflow_present.description: Customer personal data systems MUST support a right-to-erasure workflow.

privacy.pii_inventory.maintained.description: Systems processing PII MUST maintain a PII inventory entry.

privacy.sensitive_log.present.description: Services MUST NOT log raw government ID or full payment PAN values.

records.legal_hold.supported.description: Systems of record MUST support legal hold.

records.retention.schedule_documented.description: Record classes MUST have a documented retention schedule.

runtime.version.deprecated_forbidden.description: Services MUST NOT deploy on deprecated language runtimes.

saas.catalog.approved_only.description: Workforce SaaS MUST be limited to the approved catalog unless exceptioned.

security.casb.enabled.description: Unmanaged SaaS access MUST be mediated by approved CASB/proxy controls.

security.certificate.inventory_maintaine.description: TLS certificates MUST be tracked in a certificate inventory.

security.certificate.validity_days.description: Public certificates MUST NOT exceed 90 days validity.

security.dns.caa_present.description: Public DNS zones MUST publish CAA records.

security.edge.waf_required.description: Internet-facing applications MUST sit behind a WAF.

security.email_dlp.enabled.description: Corporate email MUST enable DLP for sensitive content.

security.encryption_at_rest.enabled.description: Datastores holding customer data MUST enable encryption at rest.

security.hsts.enabled.description: Public HTTPS services MUST send HSTS.

security.kms.rotation_days.description: Symmetric data keys MUST rotate at least every 365 days.

security.kms.rotation_enabled.description: Customer-managed keys MUST enable annual rotation.

security.prod_access.session_recorded.description: Interactive production access MUST be session-recorded.

security.secret_in_source.present.description: Application secrets MUST NOT be hard-coded in source.

security.secrets.max_age_days.description: Long-lived application secrets MUST rotate within 90 days.

security.tls_policy.id.description: Edge TLS MUST use an approved policy identifier.

security.vuln.critical_fix_days.description: Critical vulnerabilities MUST be remediated within 7 days.

security.vuln.high_fix_days.description: High vulnerabilities MUST be remediated within 30 days.

security.waf.enabled.description: Public HTTP edges MUST enable a web application firewall.

session.idle_timeout_seconds.description: Idle session timeout MUST NOT exceed 300 seconds.

session.server_enforced.description: Session absolute lifetime MUST be server-enforced.

session.ttl_seconds.description: Authenticated session lifetime MUST NOT exceed 600 seconds.

sre.error_budget.policy_defined.description: SLI/SLO services MUST define an error-budget policy.

sre.slo.dashboard_published.description: Services with SLOs MUST publish an SLO dashboard.

storage.snapshot.retention_days.description: Stateful production volumes MUST retain snapshots for at least 7 days.

supply_chain.dependencies.pinned.description: Application manifests MUST pin dependency versions.

supply_chain.dependency.legacy_crypto.description: Services MUST NOT depend on the discontinued legacy-crypto package.

supply_chain.license.compliance_tracked.description: Applications MUST track open-source license compliance.

supply_chain.license.id.description: Released artifacts MUST use licenses from the approved set.

supply_chain.registry.internal_required.description: Builds MUST pull private packages from the internal registry.

vendor.assurance.soc2_or_equivalent.description: Critical vendors MUST provide SOC 2 or equivalent assurance.

vendor.dpa.required.description: Vendors processing personal data MUST have a signed DPA.

vendor.offboarding.checklist.description: Vendor offboarding MUST follow a checklist including access revocation and data return/destruction.

vendor.security.questionnaire_required.description: New vendors processing company or customer data MUST complete a security questionnaire.
